title: Create ChatMessage and MessageList components
description:
Create react_ui/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx and react_ui/src/components/MessageList.tsx.

ChatMessage.tsx:
- Props: { message: Message } imported from ../types
- Renders a message bubble with role-based alignment: user messages right-aligned, assistant messages left-aligned
- Shows the message content in a rounded container with role-based background colors (user: indigo-600, assistant: gray-700)
- Shows an optional timestamp below the bubble if message.timestamp is present
- Uses Tailwind classes only; no custom CSS or inline styles

MessageList.tsx:
- Props: { messages: Message[]; isLoading: boolean }
- Renders a scrollable div container (Tailwind overflow-y-auto, flex-col)
- Maps messages to ChatMessage components with a key derived from index and role
- When isLoading is true, shows a typing indicator at the bottom: three animated dots (Tailwind animate-bounce) in a stylized assistant bubble
- Auto-scrolls to bottom when messages change: use a useEffect + ref that sets container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight
- Renders an empty state when messages is empty and not loading: a subtle 'Start a conversation' prompt

Import Message type from ../types.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/types.ts

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: ChatMessage renders user messages right-aligned with indigo background

Only Tailwind classes are used for styling; no custom CSS
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
